title: Data on the Work of the Global Health Engineering Group
description:
Data that documents the work of the Global Health Engineering group at ETH Zurich since 2021: theses, projects and staff, computational competencies of the group, repositories and commits on GitHub, funding proposals, and records on Zenodo with their views and downloads.

Explore the data on a curated website: https://global-health-engineering.github.io/ghedata/
